title: Standard localization transport of a quasi-coherent adjunction
statement: Let i:Z→Y be any scheme morphism, with independent derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose its derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image] preserves quasi-coherent cohomology and its restriction has specified right adjoint c. There exist an equivalence qY:D_QCoh(Y)→D_QCoh(Y)_standard, a preservation witness for the standard direct image, and a right adjoint cS to that standard restricted direct image. The inclusion of qY is naturally isomorphic to the original inclusion followed by the ambient standard comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes]. The inclusion of qY followed by cS is naturally isomorphic to c followed by original inclusion and the ambient standard comparison on Z. No tensor formula or perfection hypothesis is part of this statement.

proof.text: Construct Q-comparison by whiskering the Qh comparison through the homotopy quotient. Using the factorization of homology through Q, full faithfulness of precomposition with a localization gives its natural comparison. The resulting pointwise homology isomorphisms preserve quasi-coherence. Apply Mathlib Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory to obtain the restricted equivalences qZ and qY with their inherited unit and counit.

Both direct images factor through the same functorial K-injective resolution and module pushforward before localization, by derivedModuleDirectImageFactorization. Compare their target Q functors and compare QZ with its standard model; full faithfulness of precomposition with QZ descends this comparison to the derived categories.

Use the descended direct-image comparison and the ambient counit to transport the QCoh-preservation witness. Lift the conjugation comparison to the full subcategory. Compose the adjunctions qZ.inverse ⊣ qZ.functor, the supplied adjunction, and qY.functor ⊣ qY.inverse. Transport its left side along the lifted comparison. The resulting right side is the explicit composite qY.inverse ⋙ c ⋙ qZ.functor. The inclusion comparison is reflexive; the qY unit gives the asserted right-adjoint comparison.

theorem derivedQCoh_standardAdjunction
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wZ} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (hRi : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage i).obj E.obj))
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (adjC : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage i) hRi ⊣ c) :
    ∃ (eY : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ≌
        @schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _))
      (hRiS : ∀ E : @schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z (HasDerivedCategory.standard _),
        @schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)
          ((@schemeDerivedDirectImage Z Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)
            (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i).obj E.obj))
      (cS : @schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) ⥤
        @schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)),
      Nonempty ((@schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).lift
        ((@schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).ι ⋙
          @schemeDerivedDirectImage Z Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)
            (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i) hRiS ⊣ cS) ∧
      Nonempty (eY.functor ⋙
        (@schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).ι ≅
        (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ (schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence Y).functor) ∧
      Nonempty ((eY.functor ⋙ cS) ⋙
        (@schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).ι ≅
        (c ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι) ⋙
          (schemeDerivedStandardEquivalence Z).functor)
